partnership_name.rationale: Partnership name is a header field on the return, not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule B XSD candidate list.

ein.rationale: Partnership EIN (Box D) is a header field on the main return, not a Schedule B leaf element; the EIN candidates here are all within child group elements (EntityOwnIntGrp, IndivOrEstateOwnIntGrp, etc.).

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field on Form 1065 page 1, not present as a leaf element in the Schedule B candidate list.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field on Form 1065 page 1, not present as a leaf element in the Schedule B candidate list.

entity_type.rationale: Schedule B question 1 entity type is split across multiple boolean indicators (DomesticGeneralPartnershipInd, DomesticLimitedPartnershipInd, DomesticLimitedLiabPrtshpInd, DomesticLimitedLiabilityCoInd, ForeignPartnershipInd, OtherInd); the blueprint bundles these into one category field and should be refactored into separate boolean fields matching each indicator.

sb_q2a_foreign_domestic_corp_owns_50pct.rationale: EntOwnInt50PctOrMorePrtshpInd maps to Schedule B question 2a about entities owning 50% or more interest in the partnership.

sb_q2b_individual_estate_owns_50pct.rationale: IndivEstOwn50OrMorePrtshpInd maps to Schedule B question 2b about individuals or estates owning 50% or more interest.

sb_q3a_owns_20pct_or_50pct_corp.rationale: PercentTotalVtngPwrOwnOfStkInd maps to Schedule B question 3a about the partnership owning 20%+ or 50%+ of voting power in any corporation.

sb_q3b_owns_20pct_or_50pct_entity.rationale: OwnForeignOrDomesticPrtshpInd maps to Schedule B question 3b about owning 20%+ or 50%+ interest in any foreign or domestic partnership or trust.

sb_q4_meets_small_partnership_conditions.rationale: PrtshpSatisfyAllConditionsInd maps to Schedule B question 4 about satisfying all conditions to skip Schedules L, M-1, M-2.

is_publicly_traded_partnership.rationale: PubliclyTradedPartnershipInd directly maps to Schedule B question 5 about being a publicly traded partnership.

sb_q6_debt_canceled_modified.rationale: DebtCancelledForgivenModifInd maps to Schedule B question 6 about debt canceled, forgiven, or modified.

sb_q7_form_8918_material_advisor.rationale: FiledOrRequiredFileForm8918Ind maps to Schedule B question 7 about filing Form 8918.

sb_q8_foreign_financial_account.rationale: ForeignFinancialAccountInd maps to Schedule B question 8 about having a foreign financial account.

sb_q8_foreign_country.rationale: @foreignCountryCd is the attribute on ForeignFinancialAccountInd holding the foreign country name for question 8.

sb_q9_foreign_trust.rationale: ReceivedDistributionFrgnTrInd maps to Schedule B question 9 about receiving distributions from or being grantor of a foreign trust.

has_section_754_election.rationale: Section754ElectionInd maps to Schedule B question 10a about having a section 754 election in effect.

sb_q12_distributed_tenancy_in_common.rationale: TenancyInCommonInd maps to Schedule B question 12 about distributing a tenancy-in-common or undivided interest.

sb_q16a_filed_form_1099.rationale: RequiredToFileForms1099Ind maps to Schedule B question 16a about whether payments were made requiring Form 1099 filing.

sb_q16b_will_file_form_1099.rationale: RequiredForms1099FiledInd maps to Schedule B question 16b about whether the required Form(s) 1099 were or will be filed.

sb_q19_chapter3_chapter4_payments.rationale: RequiredToFileForms1042Ind maps to Schedule B question 19 about payments requiring Forms 1042/1042-S under chapter 3 or 4.

sb_q20_form_8938_specified_domestic.rationale: RequiredToFileForm8938Ind maps to Schedule B question 20 about being a specified domestic entity required to file Form 8938.

sb_q21_section_721c_partnership.rationale: Section721cPartnershipInd maps to Schedule B question 21 about being a section 721(c) partnership.

sb_q22_disallowed_interest_royalty.rationale: NondedIntRoyaltyUndSect267AInd maps to Schedule B question 22 about interest or royalty disallowed under section 267A.

sb_q23_section_163j_election.rationale: Section163jElectionInd maps to Schedule B question 23 about a section 163(j) election for real property or farming business.

sb_q25_qualified_opportunity_fund.rationale: Form8996AttachedInd maps to Schedule B question 25 about the partnership intending to self-certify as a qualified opportunity fund.

sb_q27_section_1707_transfers.rationale: TransfersSubjectToDisclRqrInd maps to Schedule B question 27 about transfers subject to Regulations section 1.707-8 disclosure requirements.

sb_q30_digital_asset.rationale: VirtualCurAcquiredDurTYInd maps to Schedule B question 30 about receiving, selling, or disposing of a digital asset during the tax year.

sb_q32_subchapter_k_election_out.rationale: ElectOutSubchapterKSect761Ind maps to Schedule B question 32 about electing out of subchapter K under section 761.

is_bba_election_out.rationale: ElectOutUnderSection6221bInd maps to Schedule B question 33 about electing out of the centralized partnership audit regime under section 6221(b).
